title: EightyOne factory spec
description: A company's setup, by name. Sections and fields left out are not touched.

productionOutputStorageUnit.description: Where finished production goes: "<site or warehouse> / <storage unit>"

ncrTaskType.description: Task type used for non-conformance reports (NCRs)

kittingTaskType.description: Task type used for kitting work orders

documentApprovalTaskType.description: Task type used to approve documents

ecnTaskType.description: Task type used for engineering change notices

category.description: What the status means for analytics: RUNNING, IDLE, DOWN, MAINTENANCE or OFFLINE

isDefault.description: The status new SSUs start in (one per company)

code.description: Short code; with the kind, the key (else the label)

parent.description: Code (or label) of a reason of the same kind this one refines

name.description: Unique in the company. In a factory, a site is a floor or area

address.description: Full address. Used when the site is created; not changed afterwards

storageUnits.description: Units of the site's own store (each SSU also gets its own unit automatically; those aren't listed)

name.description: Unique within its site or warehouse

description.description: Where it is and what it holds (aisle, rack, …); its map position comes from the site's address

ssus.description: Machines, lines and other units on this site, as a tree

name.description: Unique within its site or warehouse

description.description: Where it is and what it holds (aisle, rack, …); its map position comes from the site's address

parent.description: Name of the category this one belongs to

products.description: Products by SKU, with their vendors, recipe and stock policies. No prices or costs

sku.description: The product's key: unique in the company (case-insensitive)

itemClass.description: raw, wip, finished, operations (consumables, tools) or spare_part (machine spares)

unitOfMeasurement.description: Stock unit: pcs, kg, g, lb, l, ml, oz, m, cm, mm, yd, ft or in (new products: pcs)

purchasingUnitOfMeasurement.description: The unit it's bought in (new products: the stock unit)

packageQuantity.description: Stock units in one purchasing unit

category.description: Category name (from productCategories, or one the company has)

color.description: Color code used on the floor (bins, labels)

codeType.description: How the SKU is printed as a barcode

tags.description: The product's full set of tags

vendors.description: Who supplies it. Bought products only: a product with vendors can't have a recipe

vendor.description: Vendor name (from vendors, or one the company has)

leadTimeDays.description: Order-to-receipt days. When set, reorder uses it instead of the observed lead time

recipe.description: The full recipe (bill of materials): what one unit consumes. Made products only

sku.description: SKU of the component (from products, or one the company has)

quantity.description: How many one unit of the product consumes

stockPolicies.description: Minimums and reorder rules, per site or warehouse

storage.description: Site or warehouse name the policy applies to; leave out for the whole company

minQty.description: Reorder when goods on hand fall below this

safetyDays.description: Days of consumption added to the lead time when computing the reorder point

changeover.description: Checklists for a machine changeover: `setup` when this product comes onto a machine, `teardown` when it leaves. Fields as the dashboard stores them: { id, type, title }

parameters.description: The machine settings of the released version. A change cuts a new version and releases it; work orders already released keep theirs

taskTypes.description: Kinds of work, each with its form, SLAs and gates. People (default assignee, skills) come later

isQuote.description: Done tasks send an estimate to the connected books

requestInvoiceOnDone.description: Done tasks send an invoice request to the connected books

isUserGenerated.description: People can create these tasks from the mobile app

isInventory.description: Moves stock (from / to storage, bin, products)

isDataRequest.description: Asks a partner company for data

defaultUseTransit.description: Inventory moves go through the transit bin

requiresFailureCoding.description: Can't complete without problem / cause / remedy codes (maintenance)

recurrenceHours.description: Completing a task schedules the next one this many hours later (time-based PM); 0 = off

ssuStatusOnOpen.description: SSU status set when a task of this type opens

ssuStatusOnComplete.description: SSU status set when it completes

workCenter.description: For production operations: the work center that runs it

product.description: For production operations: SKU of the product it makes

outputStorageUnit.description: Where its output goes: "<site or warehouse> / <storage unit>"

parameterSet.description: Machine parameters shown at the point of work

minRank.description: Lowest rank that may do it (0 = anyone)

team.description: The team whose members see and take its tasks

defaultAssignee.description: Email of the person new tasks go to

defaultSubcontractor.description: Email of the subcontractor new tasks go to

priority.description: Priority name, or its level where names repeat

gates.description: Rules a task must meet to move into a status (stage gates); [] removes them

status.description: The gate applies when a task moves into this status

requiredFields.description: Form field titles that must be filled

requiredSignature.description: A signature field must be signed

allowedPermissionGroups.description: Only members of these permission groups may make the move

requiredReferences.description: Reference types that must be attached

form.description: The task's form, in order. Replaces the whole form when given

title.description: The question; also how gates name the field

options.description: Type-specific settings, as the Mobile Builder stores them: select → [{ "id": "1", "title": "Pass", "type": "select" }, …]; number → [{ "id": "config", "uom": "mm", "target": 10, "lsl": 9.8, "usl": 10.2, "decimals": 2 }]. Copy the shape from an export

useInIssueTitle.description: Issue forms only, on one short_text or select field: its answer names the report's task (<machine> · <answer> · <issue>). Makes the field required

routings.description: Step sequences that work orders follow

product.description: SKU of the product it makes (set when created)

blocksNext.description: A gate: later steps wait for this one when the work order is released

steps.description: The released version's steps, in order. A change cuts a new version and releases it; released work orders keep theirs

machineData.description: Per machine: signals, meters, condition rules and spare parts

signals.description: Signals the machine reports: declared ahead of time, or annotated once they arrive. Never removed

key.description: The signal's key as the machine connector reports it

isMeter.description: A counter that accumulates into a meter (usage-based PM)

isRunState.description: The state signal downtime detection reads (one per machine)

runningValue.description: The run-state value that means running

meters.description: Manual meters (hours, cycles read by people). Signal-fed meters come from signals marked isMeter

conditionRules.description: Condition-based maintenance: open a task when a value crosses a limit or a meter advances

mode.description: threshold: a signal crosses a limit; meter_delta: every N units of a meter

threshold.description: The limit, or the interval in meter units

taskType.description: The task type of the task it opens

spareParts.description: The machine's spare parts, by product SKU

flows.description: Automations: a task's status change creates the next task

startsWith.description: The task type that starts the flow (set when the flow is created; one flow per type)

enabled.description: false: paused, creates no tasks. Left out: unchanged (new flows run)

inheritAssignee.description: Tasks it creates take the triggering task's assignees

nodes.description: The task types on the canvas

from.description: Task type whose status change triggers

to.description: Task type of the task created

edges.description: When a task of `from` reaches `onStatus`, a task of `to` is created

issues.description: Issue reports people can file (from the app or a QR code)

name.description: Unique in the company: what people pick when they report

taskType.description: The task type of the task a report opens

form.description: The report form, in order. Replaces the whole form

title.description: The question; also how gates name the field

options.description: Type-specific settings, as the Mobile Builder stores them: select → [{ "id": "1", "title": "Pass", "type": "select" }, …]; number → [{ "id": "config", "uom": "mm", "target": 10, "lsl": 9.8, "usl": 10.2, "decimals": 2 }]. Copy the shape from an export

useInIssueTitle.description: Issue forms only, on one short_text or select field: its answer names the report's task (<machine> · <answer> · <issue>). Makes the field required

permissions.description: Every permission the group grants (area:verb). The full set: listing replaces it

roles.description: What people are; each role grants one permission group

name.description: Unique in the company: what someone is (Technician, Dispatcher, Admin, …)

permissionGroup.description: The one permission group the role grants

people.description: Users already in the company, by email: their roles, teams, skills. Specs never invite

email.description: A user already in the company: specs never invite anyone

roles.description: All of the person's roles (at least one): their permissions are the union

address.description: Full address. Used when created; not changed afterwards

inspectionPlans.description: Which receipts or products must be inspected, and how

appliesTo.description: When it applies: receiving (incoming goods) or in_process

product.description: SKU of the product it covers

samplingRule.description: How many to inspect, e.g. { "mode": "sample", "sampleSize": 5 } or { "mode": "all" }

guidance.description: What the company tells every AI agent: company-wide and on specific machines, work centers, products, task types

ref.description: Which one (not for company): an SSU path ("Site / Line / Machine"), a work center name, a product SKU, a task type name

body.description: What every agent should know (company: up to 4000 characters; one subject: 1000)

thresholds.description: stopMinutes: a stop longer than this matters; scrapPercent: scrap above this matters

name.description: Unique among its siblings: the SSU's path (site / parent / … / name) is its key

status.description: SSU status name (from ssuStatuses, or one the company has)

assetClass.description: Free-form grouping, e.g. CNC, press, gauge

make.description: Machine make, from the global machine catalog (factories only); existing spellings are reused

model.description: Machine model of that make (needs a make)

sku.description: Model-level SKU / part number (not a serial number)
